name: thalibento
description: ThaliBento: meal promises that survive every hand-off (JAL-PS-01)

scripts.dev:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m watchfiles --filter python --sigint-timeout 1 app.devserver.run backend/app
scripts.demo: npm run build && node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && node scripts/py.mjs -m pytest -q backend/tests
